changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: The U.S. strikes Iran for a third weekend as Iran retaliates by hitting Gulf nations, Sen. Lindsey Graham died Saturday at the age of 71, Congress returns from recess this week.

changes.title: US and Iran Trade Strikes as Ceasefire Deal Efforts Unravel
changes.summary: The United States and Iran traded even more attacks, some of the most intense in months, as the already fragile ceasefire continues to unravel. changes.title: A Look at Lindsey Graham’s Political Legacy and Impact
changes.summary: Meet the Press Moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY to discuss Sen. Lindsey Graham’s vast political legacy and share what he was like off camera. She also breaks down how his death impacts United States foreign policy with the wars in Iran and Ukraine.

changes.title: The U.S.-Iran ceasefire grows more distant. And, Congress faces a consequential week
changes.summary: The U.S. and Iran exchanged fire over the weekend amid tensions over the Strait of Hormuz. And, Congress returns from recess facing tight deadlines. (Image credit: Majid Saeedi).

changes.title: Strait of Hormuz Ship Traffic Falls to Lowest Point in a Month After Strikes
changes.summary: Shipping activity plummeted after Iran attacked a ship, setting off U.S. strikes. Little crude oil is being transported through the critical waterway.

changes.title: Oil Rises After Weekend of Back-and-Forth Strikes by U.S. and Iran
changes.summary: The renewed hostilities posed fresh risks to ships seeking to navigate the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: U.S. and Iran trade strikes and conflicting claims about the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: U.S. Central Command announced a new wave of strikes against Iran aimed at stopping the attack of commercial ships traveling through the Strait of Hormuz. The strikes come as Iran claims the Strait is closed, something U.S. officials dispute. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez has the latest from the Middle East.

changes.title: Politics chat: Lindsey Graham dies at 71, Congress back in session, U.S. strikes Iran
changes.summary: South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham's sudden death at 71 has shocked Washington. Once a fierce critic of then-candidate Donald Trump, he became one of the president's most consistent defenders.
